opportunities.title: Deliver responsive modern-format images
opportunities.detail: Image delivery has an estimated 4,411 KiB and 15,700 ms LCP saving. The page includes a 2,000×1,250 dashboard image plus several large logo and CTA images that can be resized and encoded for their rendered slots.

opportunities.title: Cache static image assets efficiently
opportunities.detail: Lighthouse estimates 4,184 KiB of cache-lifetime savings, including 15,750 ms for LCP. Immutable, edge-cached static assets would avoid repeatedly transferring the page's large image payload.

opportunities.title: Remove render-blocking client assets
opportunities.detail: Render-blocking requests are estimated to cost 1,430 ms of FCP. The outline also identifies a 59,848-byte blocking script from the page host, which a static rebuild can defer or eliminate.

opportunities.title: Minimize main-thread JavaScript work
opportunities.detail: JavaScript bootup takes 1.3 s and Lighthouse estimates 350 ms of TBT savings. A mostly static landing page does not need the current blocking client-script footprint.

opportunities.title: Ship only critical CSS
opportunities.detail: Lighthouse identifies 55 KiB of unused CSS, with estimated savings of 250 ms FCP and 300 ms LCP. Inline critical styles and a small page-specific stylesheet can remove this delay.

opportunities.title: Reserve image layout space
opportunities.detail: Lighthouse reports unsized images. Explicit intrinsic dimensions and responsive aspect ratios for the hero, logos, and CTA image protect the existing layout from late image shifts.

criteria.rationale: The fixture has major image, render-blocking, and JavaScript findings; a static edge-served rebuild should materially raise the score.
Image delivery and caching audits each estimate roughly 15.7 s of LCP savings; responsive cached images target good LCP.
Render-blocking requests alone estimate 1,450 ms FCP savings; critical CSS and no blocking script target good FCP.
Bootup work is 1.3 s and Lighthouse estimates 350 ms TBT savings; minimal client JavaScript targets good TBT.
The only listed script host transfers 59,848 bytes and blocks rendering; the static landing page can require very little JavaScript.
